title: ELITE MACHINES CARRY AN AFFIX
why: His yes to suggestion 25, elite affixes, with his condition that an elite should be a different colour or obviously different. An elite machine (the eight percent that already have a bit over twice the health) now carries exactly one affix, and every affix is as common as the others. SHIELDED (cyan) has a shield worth half its health that soaks your rounds first, drawn as a bubble that thins as you shoot it; a blast, a mine or fire goes straight past it, so that is the answer. VOLATILE (orange) explodes when it dies and hurts you and anything near it. FAST (yellow) is a third quicker on its feet. MENDER (green) repairs every machine within a long reach of itself, five percent every half second, with a beam to each one, so it is the one to kill first. Each wears its own colour in place of the old purple ring, with a glow and two rings on the ground and a badge over its head (a hexagon, a burst, a double chevron, a plus). A kill pays three times the points of its kind, where a plain elite pays two. Pillager elites keep their better guns and the old ring, and the Overseer has no affix. Player 2 is told the affix and sees the shield.
now: Elite machines now carry one affix each: shielded, volatile, fast or mender, each in its own colour with a badge.
